notablePrerequisites: Faeburrow Elder does not have summoning sickness.There are at least four colors among permanents you control, one of which must be blue.
description:
Activate Faeburrow Elder by tapping it, adding at least {1}{W}{U}{G}.
Cast Chain Stasis by paying {U}, untapping Faeburrow Elder and choosing to pay {2}{U} to copy Chain Stasis, targeting Faeburrow Elder.
Activate Faeburrow Elder by tapping it, adding at least {1}{W}{U}{G}.
Resolve the copy of Chain Stasis, untapping Faeburrow Elder and choosing to pay {2}{U} to copy Chain Stasis, targeting Faeburrow Elder.
Repeat from step 3.
